item: EAR is a FIELD not a scalar
detail: Each model resolves EAR along its own natural axis; the scalar is only the aggregate headline
Var(y|x) = E_theta[Var(y|x,theta)]  +  Var_theta(E[y|x,theta])
AU(x) = E_theta[ Var(y|x,theta) ]   -- irreducible; more data does not move it
EU(x) = Var_theta( E[y|x,theta] )   -- reducible; shrinks as 1/N
AU_c = E_theta[ p_c (1 - p_c) ] ;  EU_c = Var_theta[ p_c ]   for each class c
EAR(x) = 10 * log10( EU(x) / AU(x) )   in dB; signed, zero at parity
EAR = 10 * log10( sum_i EU_i / sum_i AU_i )  -- ratio of sums
REDUCIBILITY = 100 * EU / (EU + AU)   -- the 7-seg digital readout, secondary to the dB dial
For a 51-bin DOS the decomposition yields a COVARIANCE. The diagonal gives EAR(omega); off-diagonals say which bins are JOINTLY uncertain and must not be discarded
